verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as a banner should (brand+can, headline, CTA), but the headline wraps and leaves 'fizz' alone on the second line, the can is shrunk to a speck, and the legal text squeezed under the CTA is illegible. B stacks the logo, headline and legal vertically inside a 50px height, so it is badly cramped: the CTA button is jammed against the top and right edges, the can is a tiny blob crowding the left edge, and the full-width legal line pulls focus from the headline.
